scripts.sync-assets: rm -f public/openapi.yaml && mkdir -p public/api public/dist src/data && cp ../api/openapi.yaml public/api/openapi.yaml && cp node_modules/@scalar/api-reference/dist/browser/standalone.js public/scalar.js && cp ../compose.yaml ../compose.monitoring.yaml ../compose.prometheus.yaml ../prometheus.yml public/dist/ && (cd .. && go run ./scripts/dump-errors) > src/data/errors.json
scripts.dev:clean: astro dev stop; pkill -f "$PWD/node_modules/astro/bin/astro.mjs (dev|preview)" || true; rm -rf .astro node_modules/.vite && npm run dev
